description:
Configure and generate an hourly simulation report named 'ComfortCheck' to investigate overheating complaints. 

Starting with the 4StoreyBuilding project open:
1. Navigate to the Hourly Reports module in the Detailed Interface.
2. Create a new Hourly Report named 'ComfortCheck'.
3. Configure it to export two variables for the entire year (8760 hours):
   - Global Variable: AMBIENT-T (Outdoor dry-bulb temperature)
   - Space Variable: ZONE-T (Zone temperature) specifically for the space 'T.S31' (Top Floor South)
4. Run the full annual simulation.
5. Save the project.

The goal is to have the hourly data generated and the project configuration saved.
